title: Illustrated typography / Wrapped food

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Make packaging copy respond to the object so identification and appetite can be communicated together.
strategic_value: Food-shaped lettering and distinct colors can give Burger King wrappers character without relying on photographs.
demonstration: Seven wrapped items lie on brown; large colored phrases follow round or elongated food forms.
practical_value: Compare how the same lettering approach adapts to different wrapped shapes.

content_islands.name: Round packs
content_islands.spec: Distribute circular wrapped items with curved lettering across the composition.

content_islands.name: Elongated packs
content_islands.spec: Place longer wrappers near the edges, using stretched phrase arrangements to suit their forms.

reference_purposes.Application: The image applies shaped typography to a family of food wrappers.
reference_purposes.Expression: Large warm-colored phrases dominate the white packaging.

ingredient.name: Shaped packaging lettering
ingredient.role: Identify food while expressing its sensory character.
ingredient.application: Observe phrase shapes fitted to round and elongated wrappers.
ingredient.scope: Case-study application example; individual phrases and color assignments are not generalized as universal rules.
